question: Richard Feynman named the easiest person to fool. How easy are you?
answer: Richard Feynman said the easiest person to fool is you. The first principle is that you must not fool yourself. No one wants your ideas to be right more than you do.
move: Check your own ideas hardest: you are the easiest person to fool.
